g.text: «a task: a step or a model run»
«step or model of the registry (descriptions diagram)»
«evidence: a determinant found by a tool»
«trust level, or one piece of evidence»
Colours and term boxes as in the descriptions diagram (a box stands for any subclass of the term shown).
Multiplicities are those required by the AMRF SHACL shapes; links without one are not constrained, except as stated below.
An activity has at least one prov:wasAssociatedWith; a finished one also has prov:endedAtTime and a prov:SoftwareAgent.
A result has a verdict (one of the NCIt terms: resistance, intermediate or susceptibility result, presumptive positive, not detected),
a probability (schema:value) or both. oa:hasTarget is the activity when there is no result entity. Some properties are omitted.
